name: strict_preference_horizon_diagnostic_v1
purpose: Measure H4 target informativeness and H4 versus longer-horizon preference stability.
trajectory: exact H=4 eviction-loss oracle trajectory with lexicographic H4 tie break
target_semantics: Shared build_candidate_rows_for_full_cache_state eviction_loss_label with LRU continuation.
